verdict.rationale: Hightouch publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 spec and a rendered REST reference at docs/api-reference, generated via Redoc from that spec, with per-endpoint request/response schemas. The evidence explicitly notes that no live try-it runner is documented, and the API guide gives only a URL-plus-bearer-token example rather than runnable snippets, so the interactive, runnable part of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: an in-browser try-it/runnable request console, runnable code examples per endpoint, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the reference's interactivity.
